title: Configuration word length bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$, and let $s\in\mathbb{N}$. For every Boolean list $r$, the length of the encoded configuration word is at most the length of the pair encoding of $x$ with the pair encoding of that configuration word and $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
